name: cookie-banners
description: Checks EU cookie banner text, buttons, consent settings and cookie lists; gives corrected wording, specific changes and the evidence needed. Use when you have banner text, screenshots or CMP exports and want corrected choices, a settings handoff or evidence gaps. Applies the EDPB report and scoped French CNIL guidance, including measurement exemptions and authenticated cross-device choices. Works from pasted material without an account or setup.
